blocks.text: Equilibrium ko tab parha jata hai jab yeh sharaait (conditions) poori hon:

items: Equilibrium ki halat sirf reversible reactions par lagu hoti hai.
Equilibrium sirf tab ban sakta hai jab reaction ka container band ho. Reactants ya products ka koi hissa bahar nikalne na diya jaye.

blocks.alt: Do bartan jin mein CaCO3(s) ki surkh, CaO(s) ki hari aur CO2(g) ki chhoti surmai golian hain. (a) Band bartan: neeche CaCO3 aur CaO ka mixture aur oopar CO2 qaid. (b) Oopar se khula bartan: taqreeban sara thos CaO ban chuka aur CO2 munh se nikal rahi hai. Har bartan ke neeche CaCO3(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO2(g). Neeche nishanon ki key.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.2: (a) Band nizam mein equilibrium qaim hota hai (b) Khule nizam mein equilibrium qaim nahi ho sakta (kitab ki Figure 8.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono bartanon mein CaCO₃(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO₂(g) ho raha hai. (a) Band bartan mein CO₂ andar hi rehti hai, is liye woh CaO se mil kar dobara CaCO₃ bana sakti hai: reverse reaction bhi chalti hai aur equilibrium ban jata hai. (b) Khule bartan mein CO₂ bahar nikal jati hai, reverse reaction nahi ho pati aur aakhir mein taqreeban sara CaCO₃ CaO ban jata hai: equilibrium nahi banta.

items: Equilibrium ke liye reversible reaction aur band container zaroori hain.
CaCO₃ ⇌ CaO + CO₂ sirf tab equilibrium mein aata hai jab CO₂ bahar na nikal sake.
